en.headline: Chan Yui-lam takes Hong Kong’s second gold at Asian Para Games
en.dek: The swimmer won the women’s 100 metres butterfly S14 in 1 minute 5.19 seconds, with teammate Lau Chiu-kee claiming bronze.
body: Swimmer Chan Yui-lam won Hong Kong, China’s second gold medal at the Asian Para Games in Nagoya on Thursday, taking the women’s 100 metres butterfly S14 title.
Chan, the Asian record holder in the event, finished in 1 minute 5.19 seconds. Japan’s Aira Kinoshita placed second and Hong Kong teammate Lau Chiu-kee took third.
The result follows Vivian Lau’s gold in the women’s individual BC4 boccia event the previous day, giving the delegation two golds at the Games.
The China Hong Kong Paralympic Committee said Chan had entered the final as the fastest qualifier and led from the start.

zh.headline: 亞殘運陳睿琳女子蝶泳奪金 港隊再添金牌
zh.dek: 她以1分05.19秒勝出女子S14級100米蝶泳，隊友劉肖儀得銅牌，是港隊本屆第二面金牌。
body: 游泳選手陳睿琳周四在名古屋亞殘運奪得女子S14級100米蝶泳金牌，是香港、中國代表團本屆第二面金牌。
陳睿琳是該項目亞洲紀錄保持者，以1分05.19秒衝線。日本選手木下愛良得銀，港隊隊友劉肖儀得銅。
此前一天，劉慧茵已在女子個人BC4級硬地滾球奪金，港隊至今共得兩金。
中國香港殘疾人奧委會指，陳睿琳以預賽最快時間晉級，並從起跳一直領先。
